model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в максималната стойност на активацията за различни компоненти на базов модел през отделните слоеве, като носи заглавието „Massive Activation of baseline". Оста X е обозначена като „Layer", използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23 и етикети, разположени през интервал от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Max Activation Value", също с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 1600, с етикети през интервал от 200 единици (0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400, 1600).

В графиката са представени четири линии. Първата линия, „attn_output", е изобразена в син цвят с пунктирано-точков стил. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до приблизително слой 5, след което се повишава рязко до около 1400 при слой 5–6, задържа се на високи стойности до около слой 7, след което спада обратно близо до 0 и остава ниска до приблизително слой 20, където отново се повишава до около 700 при слой 23. Втората линия, „attn_residual", е изобразена в оранжев цвят с точков (пунктиран) стил. Тя също остава близо до 0 до слой 5, след което рязко нараства до около 1400–1500 при слой 5–6, задържа се на високи стойности до приблизително слой 13, където спада до около 0, и остава ниска до края, с леко повишение около слой 22–23. Третата линия, „ffn_output", е изобразена в зелен цвят с пунктирано-точков стил. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до слой 5, рязко нараства до около 1400 при слой 5, след което бързо спада обратно до ниски стойности около слой 7. Между слоеве 7 и 12 остава близо до 0, след което показва рязък връх до около 500 при слой 13, спада отново и остава ниска до около слой 20, където се повишава до приблизително 300–400 при слой 22–23. Четвъртата линия, „ffn_residual", е изобразена в червен цвят с плътен стил. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до слой 4–5, след което рязко нараства до около 1500 при слой 5–6 и се задържа на относително стабилно ниво около 1500–1570 от слой 6 до приблизително слой 21, където показва лек връх до около 1580, след което спада до приблизително 700 при последния слой 23.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," displays the maximum activation value across different layers of a neural network for four distinct components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 1600, with major tick intervals of 200. The first line, "attn_output," is shown in blue with a dash-dot line style and no distinct markers; it remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 5, then rises sharply to around 1400 at layer 5, drops back down to near 0 around layer 7, stays near 0 until approximately layer 13, spikes again to roughly 400 around layer 13–14, returns to near 0, and then rises again starting around layer 20 to reach approximately 700 by layer 23. The second line, "attn_residual," is depicted in orange with a dotted line style; it stays near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 5, then jumps steeply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, continues rising gradually to around 1500–1600 near layer 7–8, remains at roughly 1500 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 300 by layer 23. The third line, "ffn_output," is shown in green with a dash-dot line style; it remains near 0 from layer 0 to approximately layer 5, spikes to around 1400 at layer 5, drops back to near 0 around layer 6–7, stays low until approximately layer 13 where it spikes to around 500, returns to near 0, then rises again around layer 20–21 to approximately 400 before dropping back near layer 23. The fourth line, "ffn_residual," is displayed in red with a solid line style; it stays near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 5, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, increases further to around 1500–1550 by layer 6–7, maintains a relatively stable plateau near 1500 through approximately layer 20, and then drops to around 1500 at layer 22 before rising slightly to approximately 1600 at layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot illustrates the massive activation behavior of a baseline model by showing the maximum activation value across different layers for four different components of a transformer architecture. The x-axis represents "Layer," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Max Activation Value," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200.

Four lines are shown. The "attn_output" line (blue, dash-dot style) remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 5, then rises sharply to around 1400 at layer 5, stays elevated near 1400 through about layer 6, then drops back to near 0 from roughly layer 7 through layer 20, before rising again to approximately 700 at layers 22–23. The "attn_residual" line (orange, dotted style) similarly remains near 0 until layer 5, where it jumps sharply to approximately 1400, then continues to rise slightly to around 1500–1550 through layers 6–12, drops briefly near layer 13 to around 500, recovers to approximately 1550 through layers 14–20, and then drops to around 300 near layer 23. The "ffn_output" line (green, dash-dot style) stays near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 4, spikes to roughly 600 around layer 5, drops back near 0 from layers 7 through 12, rises sharply to approximately 500 around layer 13, returns near 0 through layers 15–20, and then increases to around 300 near layer 23. The "ffn_residual" line (red, solid style) remains near 0 from layer 0 through layer 4, rises steeply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, increases further to about 1550 by layer 7, remains relatively flat around 1550 through layer 20, then drops to approximately 700 at layer 22 before rising back to around 1550 at layer 23.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm zeigt die maximale Aktivierungswerte über verschiedene Schichten eines Baseline-Modells, betitelt „Massive Activation of baseline". Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, weist eine lineare Skala auf und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Max Activation Value" beschriftet, ebenfalls linear skaliert, und reicht von 0 bis etwa 1600, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400 und 1600. Es werden vier Linien dargestellt. Die Linie „attn_output" ist blau, strichpunktiert und mit keiner deutlichen Markierung versehen; sie verläuft von Layer 0 bis etwa Layer 4 nahe bei 0, steigt dann bei Layer 5 sprunghaft auf etwa 1400 an, fällt bei Layer 6 wieder auf nahe 0 zurück, bleibt bis etwa Layer 12 nahe 0, zeigt bei Layer 13 einen erneuten Anstieg auf etwa 500, fällt danach wieder ab und steigt ab Layer 20 erneut auf etwa 300 bei Layer 23. Die Linie „attn_residual" ist orange und gepunktet; sie verläuft bis Layer 4 nahe 0, springt bei Layer 5 auf etwa 1400, steigt weiter auf etwa 1500 bei Layer 6 und bleibt auf einem Plateau von etwa 1550 bis Layer 20, bevor sie bei Layer 23 auf etwa 1600 leicht ansteigt. Die Linie „ffn_output" ist grün und strichpunktiert; sie bleibt bis Layer 4 nahe 0, springt bei Layer 5 auf etwa 1400, fällt bei Layer 6 auf nahe 0 zurück, zeigt bei Layer 13 einen Anstieg auf etwa 500, fällt wieder ab und steigt ab Layer 20 auf etwa 600 bei Layer 22, bevor sie bei Layer 23 auf etwa 300 abfällt. Die Linie „ffn_residual" ist rot und durchgezogen; sie verläuft bis Layer 4 nahe 0, steigt bei Layer 5 steil auf etwa 1400 an, erreicht bei Layer 6 etwa 1530 und verbleibt auf einem Plateau von etwa 1530–1550 bis Layer 20, fällt dann bei Layer 22 auf etwa 1500 ab und steigt bei Layer 23 wieder auf etwa 1550 an.
